entities.name: Kiliaen van Rensselaer
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Kiliaen van Rensselaer was a Dutch diamond and pearl merchant from Amsterdam who was one of the founders and directors of the Dutch West India Company, being instrumental in the establishment of New Netherland.
